A four week old lamb with a broken leg has been dumped at an animal farm. Chris has decided little Leroy deserves a shot at life and takes the lamb back to the clinic to try to save his fractured leg and his life.
A tiny penguin has washed up on Bondi beach after a storm. He's malnourished and having trouble standing up. When Dr Chris discovers the shocking issue, he must make a tough decision.

Chris leads an Australian vet team overseas to help the animal victims of Fiji's devastating cyclone. Working with him is his dad, Graeme, a vet with 42 years experience. Together they stitch up a horse which has been ripped apart by a piece of flying corrugated iron roof. Lisa has to make the adjustment from her hi-tech hospital at home to treating animals in primitive conditions. Chris is also invited to an exclusive island resort to treat a cantankerous pet pig.
A hit-and-run victim collapses in a designer dress shop. Willow, a seven-year-old Husky, can only drag herself along the ground. Chris comes to the rescue, but will Willow ever be able to walk again?

Chris has a second call out. This time, it’s a Norwich terrier struggling to deliver her first litter of pups. It’s an emotional rollercoaster as Chris tries to save the puppies and keep the mother alive.

Three-month-old rescue puppy Tyson is being fostered by a family for just one week. But when foster Mum, Melissa takes the puppy to Chris for a routine check-up she is confronted with terrible news. Tyson needs major heart surgery, or he will die. Despite the expense, the family decide to adopt Tyson because they know no one else will give him a home in his condition. Will Tyson survive the open-heart surgery and have a happy future with his new family?

Chris has rushed to the Australian Reptile Park to handle an emergency. Two Tasmanian devil babies, Lara and Lily have been struck down with a mystery illness and are close to death. Can Chris save the two critically ill sisters or is the entire devil population at the park in danger of being wiped out?
Two boxer puppies are found by police wandering the streets. After treating the dogs, he must find the owners. The trouble is Chris is bonding with the puppies and is going to find it hard to let go.

A miniature horse who is suffering from dwarfism disease was not meant to survive past six months. However his loving owner and a dedicated band of vets have beaten the odds and kept two-year-old Koda alive. Australia's smallest horse is also a regular visitor at the Royal Children's Hospital in Melbourne and lights up the lives of hundreds of sick kids. Now, however, the brave Koda faces another life threatening operation. Chris will be part of the elite surgical team that will decide Koda's fate.

Can Chris save 14-week-old bunny Alice as her two little owners look on? Meanwhile, a runaway dog decides to join the Bondi clinic staff, and a normally high-energy coolie comes into Sash with paralyzed back legs.

A beautiful kelpie is brought to Chris in a terrible state. A knock to the head as a puppy has caused severe balance problems but his condition is now deteriorating rapidly. His loving owner Heidi already has a baby to look after but she is constantly assisting Jasper and cannot bear the thought of losing him. In desperation, she looks to Chris for an answer. A brain scan shows his problems are inoperable but Chris refuses to give in.

Jen brings in her son's dog Jewel to Dr Chris to find out if she's expecting. The complication? This is an unplanned pregnancy and Jen suspects the father is her own dog, Token. X rays prove Jewel is having a football team of puppies. Get ready for a long night of anxiety, sadness and ultimately joy as Dr Chris helps Jewel through her ordeal. Funny scenes as proud father, Token keeps a close eye on proceedings to make sure his offspring are being well looked after.
A beautiful pig is about to become pork chops if she keeps digging up the family property with her broken nose ring. Her owner begs Chris to find a way to stop the execution.

Honey the spoodle leapt from a car doing 40 km/h to chase a cat. She survived, but how bad are her injuries? Owner Ilana's riddled with guilt for not strapping her in—and wait till you see Honey's reaction when she hears cats out the back.
Chris finally has a weekend off vet duties and is heading to Newcastle to catch up with his parents. But a call from his dad about a bizarre snake emergency sends him on a fascinating detour.

Even in times of globalization, some things remained different in the land of the rising sun. Despite all the hectic activity, the latest technology, and the mega-metropolis Tokyo, you can still feel the meaning of tradition that seems to have survived even in times of globalization.

Life evolved in the sea, in a water-bound planet, but landmasses slowly appeared and aquatic life began to explore different ways to colonize it. Plants were the first pioneers, then insects to feast on them, and then each other.

Our ice hides a menagerie of life. Microbial ecologist Dr. Allison Fong goes on a journey to uncover the mighty power of these tiny creatures. From life-saving cures hidden in volcanic ice caves, to alien-like worms with bizarre adaptations, to blood-red algae that could transform distant glaciers.

If global shipping were a country it would be the sixth largest producer of greenhouse gas emissions. But shipping companies and engineers are creating remarkable new machines to make their industry greener, using a resource that has moved man across the world's oceans for thousands of years…Wind.

Air travel is a climate killer. But if we stop flying we'll have a global logistics problem, with numerous supply chains interrupted. If we want to keep flying, it's time for a revolutionary energy transformation. Luckily, the necessary technologies already exist.

Thanks to Artificial Intelligence, robots can recognize us, drive cars, perform surgeries with precision, create art and play a perfect game of chess. But can robots also have feelings? Will we ever consider robots our friends, or love them like real humans? And above all, can they love us back?

p.d: A woman and her family repair clocks for a living during World War II, when one day a Jewish baby comes into their lives that needs to be hidden from the Nazis, and the family risks everything to protect the hidden child.
This show highlights reptiles, along with other wildlife, revealing facts about their habitats, diets and much more, all while encouraging children to overcome their fears and follow their dreams.

Missionaries of a nonprofit Christian humanitarian organisation work to share hope and spread the message of God's love by feeding, educating, and giving medical help to over 5,000 orphaned children who live in extreme poverty in Haiti.
Drenda Keesee brings a new viewpoint on what it means to be a woman in today's world and tackles the greatest concerns that presently affect women.
A daily devotional featuring beautiful landscapes from around the world, accompanied by popular hymns, uplifting worship songs and scripture readings from the Holy Bible.
Jerusalem Bureau Chief Chris Mitchell reports from the Holy Land and Middle East and provides first-hand coverage of news and events in the State of Israel from a biblical perspective.
Expert guides and scholars bring Israel's biblical history to life through ancient sites, archaeological discoveries, and modern developments.

p.t: Your Miraculous Life With Dr. Kynan B...
p.d: Dr. Kynan Bridges reveals how to operate in miracles, signs and wonders, while learning to see world events through the eyes of scripture.

A ministry broadcast originating in South Dakota takes on the mission to minister the word of God to those unable to attend traditional services of worship, including the elderly and those struggling with health issues.
Pastor Tim helps us discover how God uses pressure, persecution, and hardship to propel His purpose forward.

Prominent Christian minister Rod Parsley, of the Pentecostal World Harvest Church in Columbus, Ohio, delivers powerful and inspirational messages of Christ's love and salvation derived from the scriptures of the Holy Bible.
Pastor Larry Huch instructs viewers on how to enter into a realm of blessing and revelation through the studies of the Jewish roots of the Christian faith.
Chuck and the team investigate the recent sighting of a possible shape-shifter near Utah's Skinwalker Ranch.
An ongoing flap of UFO sightings in and out of the water off the Southern California coastline leads Chuck and the team to investigate the connection between UFOs, the military and the ocean itself.
How do Ford produce the ubiquitous white van, the Transit? And how do they ensure the Driza-bone coat lives up to its name?
A fed-up wife in Arizona secretly pleads for the Raneys to take her husband from dreamer to doer to save their homestead and family from collapsing.

Captains Sig and Sophia shift their fishing strategy as back-to-back injuries plague the Northwestern deck crew. When a Time Bandit crewman suffers a concussion, John must make a perilous harbor entry. Jake loses power in heavy seas on the Cornelia Marie.

p.t: In The Eye Of The Storm
p.d: Hurricane Idalia's 12-foot storm surge sweeps away Gulf Coast neighbourhoods as its winds overturn rush-hour traffic 350 miles away in Charleston, SC.

p.t: Gold Rush: Dave Turin's Lost Mine
p.d: Casey takes a gamble that may return to haunt him. Meanwhile, Dave travels to a secret Montana mine stacked with piles of gold-rich ore.
Tony Beets battles the Klondike winter to secure a monster excavator. As the competition for ground heats up, Fred Lewis searches for the mother lode.

p.t: Opal Hunters: Red Dirt Road Trip
p.d: Stuck in Andamooka with a broken-down vehicle, Rod and JC hit rock bottom.
Winter erupts as Johnathan hunts for crab in a secret location to which he's won exclusive rights. Plus, Sig tries his luck at a derby fishery.

Captain Keith eagerly repositions his pots when Johnathan makes an offer he simply can't refuse. Bob follows a pod of porpoises to her first big solo haul. Fired from the Wizard, Jacob chases his dream of becoming a captain to a wholly different boat.

Bob's breakout haul as a solo captain takes a turn when another vessel collides with the boat she inherited from her late parents. Cascading engine failures put Sig in a tough spot as the Coast Guard makes a surprise inspection.

With $1 million in crab at stake, the Wizard battles unrelenting 30-footers. Jake faces a devil's bargain to aid another captain, but the high road may come at a cost. Sig fights to eke out a profit from the derby. The Kodiak crew assesses the damage.

Fallers face gnarly timber challenges, but it will all be for nothing if Jared and crew can't get the 140-ton super snorkel up the mountain. A series of mechanical setbacks threatens to delay the first $100,000 barge royalty, due in less than two weeks.

p.t: Gold Rush: Dave Turin's Lost Mine
p.d: Casey takes a gamble that may return to haunt him. Meanwhile, Dave travels to a secret Montana mine stacked with piles of gold-rich ore.
JJ brings the Hummingbird back to the street and sets out to take back the spots he lost while fixing the car.
Adam is in San Juan, Puerto Rico, for an enormous deep-fried pork chop, a churrasco steak sandwich, and his biggest challenge yet: a 4kg steak platter.
The 575 is the one Ferrari that doesn't sound like a Ferrari. Jared and Lou bolt on a new Italian exhaust to give the front engine the proper sound!
Jared and Lou upgrade the suspension in a 2010 Audi R8 from the factory adaptive suspension to coil-overs; they also fabricate an air intake for better performance.
Freiburger and Finnegan try to keep a '39 Ford with a 68-year-old engine running on a 1,000-mile road trip to scope out a future project in Texas.
Derek’s not done with the Barneville, his 1962 Pontiac Bonneville. He’s reviving it with upgrades and needs help to finish it in time for a surprise.
Ant has found an iconic VW Campervan that's been abandoned mid-restoration. The interior needs a full refit, plus a suspension overhaul.
In Yorkshire, Henry and Fuzz uncover a 1951 Lea Francis Saloon: hand-built, elegant, and born in a time when motoring was a luxury.
After pro wrestler and actor John Cena makes a surprise appearance at the shop, Bill and the guys begin to customise John's small 1969 MGC to be a perfect fit.
RD shows a buyer a $1.4 million McLaren Senna. Melissa works to get a Cullinan for her client. Chadwick wants to close the deal on five Rolls Royces.
A five-year-old girl offers up her piggy bank to help get her daddy's 1968 Chevelle finished.

A repeat client wants a tall, monster-sized work truck, so the team decides to build the world's first-ever truly lifted Hummer EV. Ashley sets a company sales goal of 25 trucks at the upcoming Palm Beach Boat Show, sparking family tension.
NBA superstar Shaquille O'Neal shows up unannounced at Apocalypse to order a custom 4x4 Juggernaut truck. Frank and Pop go into firefighter training.

p.t: Diners,Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation
p.d: Guy's picking up gourmet tacos in Phoenix, a signature mac cheesy pizza in Boston, and out-of-bounds oxtails in Texas.
In Atlanta, two pals are serving up patty melt empanadas. There's a bakery in LA plating khachapuri, and a Japanese joint is dishing out BBQ pork bao.

This is a delightfully retro 45 minutes of experimental surf film shot entirely on Super 16mm.

We explore American surfing: why Tour numbers are down, motivation of youth, the amateur system, and patriotism. Rather than speculate from an office, we hit the phone, tracing the coastlines, cove peaks, and conversations to understand the state of surfing in the USA.

TAPS travels to Buffalo, New York to investigate paranormal activity occurring on three former service vessels moored at the Buffalo Naval and Military Park.

On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Franklin, Kentucky to investigate Octagon Hallwhere secret tunnels have been found under the house, which are believed to have hidden confederate soldiersduring the civil war.

The Atlantic Paranormal Society travels to Lucas, Ohio, to investigate claims of paranormal activity surrounding The Ceely Rose Murders; TAPS investigates the Bromfield Estate where questions about famous author and a family secret arise.

The Atlantic Paranormal Society travels to King George, Va., to investigate Belle Grove Plantation, which has ties to two U.S. presidents; next, the team travels to Winchester, Va., to investigate Historic Jordan Springs.

It's hard to know what's haunting the Cumberland Library and Monastery in Rhode Island. It could be nine settlers who were skinned alive and buried there in the 1600s. Or it could be the inhabitants of a monastery used for generations. Currently a library, people report voices, doors opening and slamming, and shadowy, floating monks around the property. Adam and Amy encounter something that turns the faucets on and off in a bathroom.

TAPS travels to Brunswick, Ga., to investigate the Brunswick Old City Hall, where an officer was killed in the 1890s; next, the team heads to a former worsted mill, where the caretaker is on edge and insists that the location be kept a secret.

The TAPS team explore an abandoned school in Barnegat, N.J., looking into reports that the apparition of a beloved teacher who died in 1965 is luring children inside the building. Later, they arrive in Clay County, Fla., on a mission to discover if an old courthouse and jail is haunted by the ghosts of inmates and a murdered sheriff.

TAPS return to the Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum in Weston, West Virginia, for their 200th episode, which finds the team reunited with Grant, Dustin and Joe. Efforts are made to reach former patients who suffered tragic lives in the hospital.
TAPS visits Cincinnati Music Hall on Halloween to uncover whether the thousands of people buried under the building are playing paranormal tricks.
Some new, and old cast members participate in the investigation of the Wild Turkey Distillery in Kentucky. The TAPS team looks for traces of the ghosts of the founding family members.

The Atlantic Paranormal Society travels to New York to investigate unexplained activity at the Culinary Institute of America, where many believe the spirits of Jesuit priests roam the area where they once lived when the institute was once a seminary.
To set a bride-to-be's mind at ease, TAPS checks out the venue where her wedding will be held. Then, the team examines a Connecticut mansion.
TAPS travels to the historic St. Charles, Missouri to investigate Main Street’s hauntings.

The team investigate the Burlingame and Chaffee Opera House in Carthage, Mo.; and they visit a private residence in Connecticut to help a family who believe a presence has taken over their home and children.

TAPS travel to Missouri to help three generations of a family living on what they believe to be a haunted estate; and in Massachusetts, the team investigate whether one ghost is connected to two different properties.

Glorious Gospel Church has been meeting the needs of the community since 1990. With a vision for a church that is REAL, RELATABLE, ENJOYABLE, LIFE-CHANGING And UPLIFTING, they are committed to providing church services that will enable you to experience church this way. Linked by mutual vision and values, which are based firmly in the Bible and what the Bible teaches, GGC's mandate is to express the Good News of Jesus Christ in a relatable and practical way..

Planetshakers' mission is to 'empower a generation to win a generation'. This Christian youth movement began as an annual conference in Melbourne that saw thousands of people of different ages, backgrounds and nationalities from all over the globe gather together. The movement grew and grew into an international ministry and church. Russell and Sam Evans are the senior pastors of Planetshakers City Church and Planetshakers TV showcases weekly teaching and music.
We like to call it 'soul food'. LIFE TV uses creative illustration, real life stories and biblical teaching to encourage and help viewers discover a greater purpose to their lives.

p.d: Dr. Jeremiah serves as host and teacher during this musical tour of our eternal home with special guests, including Veritas and Taranda Greene.

The In Touch program reaches the world with the Gospel with messages that tackle such issues as parenting, finances, personal crises, emotions, and relationships. Dr. Stanley fervently believes the Bible to be the inerrant Word of God, a belief strongly reflected in his teaching. Dr Charles Stanley is the author of more than 50 books.

Worry and anxiety don’t have to control your life. In this message from his series Lessons from Philippians, Pastor Bayless explains how you can break the worry habit and experience the peace of God. You’ll learn how acknowledging God in prayer, making specific requests, and giving thanks positions your heart to receive what God has promised. When you apply these biblical principles, God’s peace will guard your heart and mind—no matter what you’re facing. Be encouraged and strengthened as you discover how to trust God fully.
Join Pastor Steven in the Basin where he digs deep into scripture and breaks down the Word of God in these short conversational teachings.

PowerPoint Ministries started as a vision of Dr Jack Graham and his wife, Deb, over 20 years ago. They believed that the power of God was evident in their growing church and that His Gospel message should be spread beyond the walls of that church to the world at large. They put their faith into action and purchased airtime on the Trinity Broadcasting Network. PowerPoint Ministries was then officially launched in April 1994. Over the past 19 years, PowerPoint Ministries has grown to an expansive network of local, national, and international television and radio broadcasts. In fact, PowerPoint can be seen or heard by a potential audience of millions of television viewers and radio listeners across the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, South Africa, Iran, Russia, Israel and more. The Ministry has a vision to glorify God by introducing Jesus Christ as Lord to as many people as possible and to develop them in Christian living using the most effective means to impact the world

Experience from the weekend church service of Lakewood Church, the largest and fastest growing church in America that is inspiring millions of people around the world!

Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.
Magnify the King of Glory above every storm, letting His perfect peace guard your heart and quiet every anxious thought in your mind.

Hear inspiration for change, healing, peace and joy through his affective communication connecting you to God, the church, and the world!
You can’t change people, but God can. Today, Joyce shares encouragement for anyone praying for loved ones to know God and follow His plan.

Meet a 10-year-old boy who’s attacked by a spirit and left with the sign of the devil. Then witness a series of strange and unsettling events that take place when a woman is looking after her three-year-old niece in her new home.

When a hospital worker decides to spend the night alone in a hospital, during a terrible snowstorm, he is startled when he starts to see the ghosts of past hospital staff and patients from around the time of World War I.

Try to stay calm when Jill returns from her grandfather’s funeral and hears the bathroom water running. Then see strange spirits chase a young man through every room in his house, from the bedroom all the way down to the basement.

See what happens after Robin’s daughter leaves for the evening and Robin hears voices coming from the living room. Meanwhile, Pauline and her younger daughter notice evidence of their deceased cat Kevin when they move into a new apartment.
In this episode, the home is not a haven but a haunted ground when poltergeists take up residence where they don't belong and ruthlessly fight against eviction.

Ghost hunters share the stories that led them to a career in the paranormal; a child's game opens a portal to hell; a psychic medium stands up to the spirit of an angry man; a young girl is terrified by nightly visits from a horned demon.
As they look for a way to cross over into the afterlife, lost souls terrify the living. A shadowy entity torments a young boy, while a teen hears whispers.
Siblings are chased by a menacing shadow figure, while mournful serenades haunt a family's new home and a dark entity attacks a young boy.

Demonic entities seek control of their victims through possession; an evil spirit follows a father and daughter home from church; cousins unleash hell when they play with a spirit board; shadowy creatures wreak havoc on a girl's life.

Diabolical spirits torture and taunt their unsuspecting targets; a mother and daughter become the terrified victims of a family curse; a teen boy is attacked by an unseen force; a young girl senses an evil presence hiding in her closet.

Get dazzled as West Texas police recall a spectacular night when a 200-foot-long flying object was spotted in 13 separate locations. Then get to the bottom of a strange assault against a Scottish man that has no earthly explanation.
In Brazil, three men escape a close encounter. In Canada, a thirteen-year-old boy is blinded temporally after investigating a bizarre object.
In Ohio, two officers spot a strange bright light flying in the night sky. Police dispatch advises them to pursue the object, triggering a massive car chase.
A Chicago suburb cops a Halloween visit from mystery lights and a horseshoe-shaped vessel. Then dig into the Bucks County Wave, a cluster of over 200 UFO sightings in Pennsylvania.

Take action with US Air Force pilots after a metallic, 60-foot-long unidentified craft puts them in the crosshairs. Then meet a police constable whose lights were punched out by a brilliant beam emanating from a mysterious crash site.
Gordon Ramsay challenges the chefs to create dishes that not only taste good, but look the part as well, with his social-media followers choosing a winner.
The final four Young Guns compete in the first ever Hell's Kitchen Beach BBQ, but whose food will the party-goers enjoy the most? At dinner service, each chef has a chance at running the pass.

The final three chefs are instructed to create their own menus for the final challenge and are paired with the sous chefs to think up stunning meals. However, a night on the town with Chef Ramsay has a surprise in store.

Hell's Kitchen Young Guns Season 20 comes down to Trenton and Megan, battling for the head chef role at Gordon Ramsay Steak 2.0 in Vegas. With their brigades assembled and Ramsay's guidance, they cook their final dinner service.

The new chefs enter Hell's Kitchen and cook their signature dishes for Ramsay. It's men versus women, and the first service is a total disaster. Ramsay shuts the kitchen down and the red team lose a member.
To make sure the aspiring chefs understand exactly how much food was thrown out in the previous night's service, chef Ramsay orders them into the dumpsters to learn a crucial lesson about waste.

Teams must cook three entrees, but only one member is allowed in the kitchen at a time for five minutes. Miscommunication wreaks havoc. Prep and dinner service are full of drama, and Ramsay closes Hell's Kitchen in a rage.

Chef Gordon Ramsay puts aside the battle of the sexes and switches the chefs to even out the teams. Hell's Kitchen breaks new ground when the teams are put to the test during a lunch service cooking for a group of highly demanding customers.

For the team challenge, Ramsay tested their palates with a blind taste test. The winning team posed with Ramsay at a photo shoot for TV Guide, while the losing team cleaned the kitchen for the following service.
The contestants are taken to Los Angeles' Grand Central Market. They have twenty minutes to shop for fresh ingredients and must create a three course meal.

The contestants' speculations prove correct when Chef Ramsay combines all of them into one team. The final five proudly change into their black jackets in preparation for a test which Chef Ramsay gives regularly to prospective employees.
With just four chefs remaining, the competition becomes fierce. Who among them has what it takes to be head chef at Gordon Ramsay's new restaurant?
The contestants taste Chef Ramsay's signature dish and are given twenty minutes to replicate it. Tensions rise amongst the chefs amidst accusations of cheating.
The second series winner of Hell's Kitchen USA is decided.

Chef Ramsey offers 15 new contestants the chance to become the executive chef at his new restaurant, but things don't start off well as one hopeful's dish makes Gordon physically ill and another contestant is absent for the dinner service.

This was a wooden wonder that simply outran its foes, and took part in some of WWII's most daring missions. We get an up close look at the only running example in Europe.

This plane is the ugly-ducking aircraft that shunned the limelight, and the daylight. Learn the story of how this aircraft, an initial failure, helped win the war supporting covert operations.

Take a look at a beautifully restored example of the later, clipped-wing version of the legendary fighter-plane flown by Czech refugee pilots in the UK during wartime, featuring long-unseen test and operational footage.

Join Mike when he’s tapped to rescue the unfinished, budget-killing whole-house reno that left Bill and Marie camped out in their daughter’s home. Face historical and building code issues as the crew brings this couple’s retirement dream to life.

A man wants to renovate the kitchen in his old Victorian town home, but the contractor he hired gets behind schedule, and Mike finds out it's because the entire main floor was not up to code, and he must fix the problems before the kitchen is redone.

Feel Jim and Lisa’s heartbreak over the friendly contractor who abandoned their basement reno without fessing up that he’d underpriced the job. See how Mike and a team of specialists finally serve up the English pub this couple was thirsting for.

Head out on the hunt for investment properties with Mike and MJ, then discover a surprise that tests their father-son relationship and their business partnership. Stand back as Mike gets a lesson in treating his son as an equal.

Mike and MJ face major structural and water issues at the river house and decide to take the whole thing down to rebuild it the correct way; at the country house, they continue to solve the water issues but soon notice more water on the ground.

Play a waiting game with Mike and MJ as they try to lock down permits for the ongoing River House rebuild. Meet designer BFF Sarah Richardson at the Country House for a dose of good advice before MJ’s pre-wedding jitters get the better of him.

Mike and MJ continue work on the country house until they discover an open permit remains on the barn; back at the river house, Mike decides to hire a designer; the big day finally arrives when MJ and Lisa get married in a picturesque setting.

Discover the gaps in a home-inspection report that lulled Jennifer and Paul into a false sense of security. Join Mike’s team as they give this couple a second opinion and get to work making their downtown character home as safe and sound as it looks.

Check in with Andrew and Melissa, whose house purchase was supposed to bring security and comfort to their expanding family. See Mike outline some home inspection misses and signs of neglect that Damon and the crew will make right and watertight.

Sympathize with James and Doreen, who spotted big problems with their home inspection after the deal closed. Investigate mold and electrical issues that could put their kids in danger, and see Mike’s team bring the house up to code safely.

Nestled some 12 miles off Normandy France lays the beautiful channel Island of Jersey. Part two we fly across to Portofino in Italy.

In Paris we visit Hotel le Meurice and Hotel Plaza Athenee, then head down south to sunny Cannes and stay in the Carlton made famous of course by Elton John.
This time we visit Milan the home of fashion. In part two we are all at sea, well more on river to be truthful in beautiful Burgandy in the wine region of France.

In the episode we visit the Mother City of South Africa – Cape Town. The second half of the show is based in the distinctive blue haze of the Blue Mountains, Australia - a vast mountain area covering over a million hectares.
We visit floating Markets, Royal Palaces and the new spa and sauna of the Peninsula Hotel in Bangkok. Then it’s off to the city that's so good they named it twice… New York!

p.d: Tim visits his mate Milton in the Northern Territory to help relocate a problem croc, then back home microchips baby wombats and koalas, weighs Betty the python and then heads into the bush to check on the health of some platypus.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: Tim helps a friend move a 4-meter alligator from one pond to another, all in the name of love. He introduces us to one of his big passions, the Tasmanian Devil, and later, back at the park, extracts venom from snakes and spiders.
Chris and Lisa head to fire-ravaged Blue Mountains to help stranded animals. Chris treats a premature baby alpaca whose mum went into early labor during evacuation. The newborn cria is fading fast.

A tattoed pin-up model looks very out of place in a small outback town as she plans to marry her Aussie country boy. Also, a woman tries to lose weight after buying a wedding dress two sizes too small.
It's the Plate of Origin grand final as two teams go head-to-head to win the $100k prize money and prove that their cuisine is the best on the planet.
10 teams enter The Arena where they meet their world-class judges: Manu Feildel, Matt Preston, and Gary Mehigan. The season kicks off with Team China versus Team Australia.

Justine relishes award-winning goat cheese at La Ferme d'Ulteria, crafts a fresh salad, and collaborates with Chef Leo for the Captain's Dinner in the historic Dordogne region.
Rhys spends the day on a remote island in Northeast Tasmania and prepares a seafood lunch for his mates with crayfish and shellfish. Ben cooks a chilli pineapple upside down cake back in the kitchen.
Paul hosts a huge field day celebrating local talent, artists and producers. He strips down for fashion before impressing the crowd with farm fare.
The chefs are forced to come up with their best sweet dish to help temper the visitors who are coming back and looking for revenge, Martha and Jose are judging blind, the chefs in the cook-off.

Jamie bakes fish with prosciutto, makes scones, roasts a chicken, and prepares crispy pork noodles. Poppy Cooks shows a potato recipe and air fries an Alaskan peach.

p.d: This is the story of the Great British wedding cake - the origins of the most important cake in our lives. The three finalists from last year hope to prove that they can master it.

Actor Richard T. Jones and his wife Nancy invest in Mississippi. Ben and Erin create a beautiful home with a timeless Craftsman porch and a standout kitchen.

The Clean It Fix It team is in East London to help a young family reconfigure their flat. They create closed storage in the kitchen, and turn the living room into multifunctional area.
Amanda and Mark moved to Petersfield in Hampshire for professional reasons with children where they bought a house that needed work to suit family life. But they didn't realise how much work.
George travels to Lancashire to meet Billy, a remarkable 17 year old self-builder who single-handedly transforms a derelict narrow boat his mum bought, into a hand crafted floating holiday home.

Energy Conservationist Andrew is building a radical self-heating home. As wife Margretta yearns for a beautiful contemporary house, Andrew's focus is primarily on his gigantic thermal experiment. But will it work?
Kirstie and Phil help Jocelyn and Simon, first-time buyers who've spent 25k on rent, find a home in Hertfordshire. With high expectations and a 225k budget, will they find the charm they crave?
Kirstie and Phil assist Tara and Alistair, who seek a family home in Edinburgh's suburbs with a 600k budget. In a booming market, can they outbid competitors and navigate Scotland's system?
Kirstie and Phil aid Jonathan and Lucy, living rent-free in a pub but needing a family home. With differing wants - investment vs. family space - can they find a compromise and a new home?
Kirstie and Phil search for a family home in Somerset for Olaus and Fiona. With prices 32% higher than in Cardiff, will they find a house that meets their needs and budget in this competitive market?
Kirstie's with sewing blogger Elle and her fiance Ed, who have seen 52 properties and still can't find the perfect pad to bring them and their pug Waldo together under the same roof.
Kirstie and Phil help 24-year-old Sonia find her first property in Canterbury's hot market. Overwhelmed by competition, can they get her to the front of the queue and secure a great home?
Kirstie and Phil tackle a renovation search for Colin and Inge in the Scottish Borders. With a 150k budget and high expectations, will they find a fixer-upper that matches their artistic vision?
Kirstie and Phil search for a home in Herefordshire for Alison and Phil, who are leaving city life behind. With a 215k budget, can they find a dream home and make compromises?
Sandra and Dave search in La Duquesa, Costa del Sol. After 24 years visiting Spain, they now want their own holiday home with a sea view.
Former infantryman Ben bought a modest weatherboard in New Norfolk, northwest of Hobart. He thought it idyllic for his kids, but family issues force him to sell.
Nine amateur sewers return hoping to show judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young that they can make beautiful clothes on a miniature scale.
The remaining potters discover their wild sides this week as they create metallic effect, endangered animal sculptures and a tall, thin necked vase.

p.t: Sarah Beeny's New Life In The Country
p.d: Sarah Beeny, her husband Graham and their four boys raise two piglets on their farm in Somerset and head to Stonehenge before dawn to see the sunrise over the ancient monument.
Sandi Toksvig explores some of the UK's most remote and beautiful holiday destinations, accompanied by some of her favorite women.

p.t: I Bought It At Auction With Sarah Beeny
p.d: Sarah Beeny helps a DIY novice renovate a bungalow on a tight budget. In Stoke, Tariq races to convert a historic library into an events venue before his first wedding booking.

p.t: Long Lost Family: What Happened Next
p.d: Yasika Fernando's search for her birth mother has had repercussions. When Yasika's programme was broadcast it was watched by someone else born in the very same week and adopted from the very same convent.
Nick follows the restoration of Lincoln Cathedral, once the world's tallest building but now seriously under threat from the weather.
Peter is building an underground eco bunker that's self-sufficient, sleek and completely one of a kind. From the outside it will eventually look like a bush garden, but below ground a man cave.

Zahid and Ferzana from Leeds replace an old coast-guard station on a East Yorkshire headland with a three-storey steel and glass box to take in the sea views. But right from the start the build is fraught with issues.

Over the years, Selling Houses Australia has helped hundreds of Aussies sell their unsellable houses, but have you ever wondered what happens next? Where are the now? Find out on Inside Selling Houses Australia: New Beginnings.

Award-winning artist Steve has a very eclectic style that buyers just can't look past. Can Wendy and Dennis use their DIY skills to stretch every dollar as far as possible on this build, and lure in buyers?

Fernanda and Carlos had purchased an investment property with Fernanda's sister, Roberta and her husband, Thiago. Due to a declining rental market they need to sell so they can start their home owning journey separately.

Alan Titchmarsh visits Grantham to see Rob and Margaret Isdale who have fostered over 150 children. The team turn their backyard into a spectacular garden inspired by the famous book and film, The Secret Garden.
In the Yorkshire Dales, Angus scours a stately home for forgotten treasure.

The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomad's brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. To add to her woes, her hungry pride start rejecting her. But without her, they struggle to bring down prey.

The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK pride's territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Ava's survival skills are still intact.

p.t: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack
p.d: Welcome the rains as an emotional Julz says farewell to the dog packs. He discovers the Stork Colony pups hunting guinea fowl, and is heartened to find the Kakuli pups feeding on an antelope carcass. The playful Manzi pack corner a tough warthog.

The ocean sprawls across 70 percent of our planet and is home to as many as one million known species of plants and animals. However, it is the smallest of ocean creatures that underpins the world's largest food web - plankton. These microscopic organisms drift through the ocean's diverse habitats, triggering feeding cycles in their wake. Without them, life in the ocean would cease to exist.

For the first few weeks of life, the world is a frightening place. Danger lurks around every corner. It pays to be alert. Whether predator or prey. Any day might be your last. The race is on to grow up fast- for even the largest animals are vulnerable to attack.

If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades - but all, have lots to learn along the way. From getting to grips with their bodies and learning to feed themselves, to practicing fighting skills and learning how to form friendships. There are many hurdles along the way, but every small success could mean the difference between life and death.

For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animal's legacy. But it's not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest and most determined will win at Luangwa's mating game.

Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

Experience a roller coaster of emotions and growing pains as the sanctuary's orangutans move through six grades toward their release into the wild. Discover how Dilla's fate suddenly changes, and watch as big boy Beni goes on an unwelcome diet.

The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africa's amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed for thousands of years, evolving in different ways to a life aquatic.
Growing up in the rainforests in the heart of Colombia, a young capuchin monkey has to master his climbing skills, learn how to find food and learn to distinguish friend from foe.

From Colombia's high plains of the Páramo to its tropical forests, hummingbirds have evolved into an extraordinary number of species. Whether battling freezing rain or jungle predators, each mother must struggle to build a nest, protect her eggs.

The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.
Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate.
Chris is still in Cairns at Marlin Coast Vet Clinic. First up, Chris is called to a local crocodile park to treat Ted, a 5.4 metre monster with savage wounds to his snout after coming off second best

The rehabilitation staff turns their attention to two beavers who suddenly find themselves in need of emergency lodging; a volunteer decides to give an in-depth, personal look at what life is like inside the rehabilitation centre.

Meet best friends Tammy and Allie, who are living the dream at Wendigo Farms, with a new business, beautiful horses, and a state-of-the-art barn. Learn why running this operation isn’t all peaches and cream once harsh reality rears its ugly head.

Wake up and smell the drama as Allie cooks up a plan that’s way out of line. Meet the friend she hires without telling business manager Tammy and barn manager Megan, and feel the tension as this decision undermines the trust they’ve established.

Experience the heat of competition as Allie goes up against an old rival at Wendigo Farms’ first equestrian event. Then feel the tension skyrocket when she discovers that Megan has forgotten an important saddle back at the farm.

Sense the excitement as the Wendigo Farms staff prepare for the birth of the centre's first foal. Watch preparations kick into high gear as labour begins, then feel everyone's concern when things don't go as planned.

Go on a team retreat with Tammy as she helps everyone regroup after the tragic death of the barn's first foal. Witness the frustration as the group struggles to communicate, before Tammy takes Megan to task over her bad attitude.

Get a ringside seat at the most important equestrian event of the season, where Allie’s best efforts aren’t enough to bring home an award. Watch the day go from bad to worse when Tammy and Megan get into yet another monumental argument.

Get a first impression of Courtney, the new boarder, as Tammy and Allie grapple with managing the barn now that Megan has resigned. Tag along with Megan, who visits a friend in Alberta looking for greener pastures and a fresh start.

Brace for fallout as Tammy blows a gasket after Courtney is rude to Jamie and Alex. In Alberta, Megan isn't as lucky finding new employment as she'd hoped, and feels the stress as she finally decides to head home.
Megan swallows her pride and asks for her job back at Wendigo Farms. Tammy's hot young date shows up at the barn uninvited. Allie briefs Mike on a drastic strategy for winning Tammy back.

Celebrate as Allie cashes in on a horse while Tammy shocks the barn by announcing her wedding is next weekend. Join a whirlwind dress-shopping spree and watch Megan take over Allie's lesson with Courtney—with less than stellar results.

Beverly Mahood meets with a couple and their children to find a new dog to adopt that will get along well with their older family dog. The family spends time with three different dog breeds in the hope of finding the perfect puppy.

Beverly meets with a family of five who hope to rescue an older dog, so the host introduces the family to a German shepherd, a Shetland sheepdog, and a basset hound mixed-breed dog to see which canine best suits the family.
A bobcat kitten is desperate for Hope's assistance, but the little orphan has a way of creating some full-size problems all by itself.

The MythBusters tackle two tasty tales. First, can you fire prawns from an air cannon through flour, egg wash and breadcrumbs into a fireball to cook the perfect tempura on a plate?
When it comes to countdowns the Myth busters have been ramping it up for 14 years. And they’re celebrating their explosive history with two spectacular tall tale big bangs.

In their 14-year history, the Myth Busters have used over 3500 human guinea pigs and in this Volunteer Special, they’re paying homage to every single one! First, they summon up an army of 200 zombies to find out what is the ultimate weapon when the apocalypse comes.

The MythBusters have counted down to lift off and lit the fuse on approximately 960 rockets and fireworks. In this Rocket Special Adam and Jamie are tackling the all time fan favourite explosive technology in a one mega-myth in-depth episode.

In over 14 years the MythBusters have detonated somewhere in the region of 1,000 explosions. In this episode-with-a-twist the team is reversing their SOP and doing something they’ve never done before - an implosion caused by a vacuum.
In this episode that level of fan interaction has peaked in a Reddit Special. Adam and Jamie literally put the editorial of the show in the fans hands.

In this special episode, the MythBusters reveal what’s in store for their go big then go home final season, while also pulling back the curtain to showcase how this epic series got made with a behind-the-scenes exclusive.
When it comes to destroying cars, the MythBusters are experts and in this episode, they’re doing it in style!

Since 2002, Adam and Jamie have used science to separate fact from fiction in spectacular style! But, as the saying goes, all good things must come to an end and MythBusters is no exception. Luckily, the guys are going out with a bang.

For this final hour of the television icon that is MythBusters, the 5 hosts are reunited for one last hurrah! Deep within M5, Adam, Jamie, Kari, Tory and Grant join forces once more to together peel back the curtain as never before to give a suitably epic, enlightening and emotional finale to the best science show on television.

Adam and Jamie revisit their first ever duct tape episode—discussing, dissecting and delighting in the classic. Features never-before-seen footage, viewer QAndA and behind-the-scenes insights from the legends.
Adam Savage and Jamie Hyneman reunite to reflect on their adventures on Duct Tape Island, using only the legendary tape to survive and provide a means of rescue. (Final)

The team return for some fan inspired fables in Viewers Special, The Three-quel! Can bamboo be used as an instrument of torture? Will the Brandy on a St Bernard's collar keep you warm until rescue arrives?
Up, up and away! Mythbusters take on comic book classics in this Superhero Special. Now, I know what you're thinking hang on, you can't test superhero powers. They can't possibly exist.
Kari, Tory, and Grant risk their lives testing the classic myth—does wearing red really make bulls see red?
Cambodia is a country that lies almost entirely within the Mekong basin, flanked by Thailand, Laos and Vietnam.

Explore a region that provides shelter to a wide array of life, despite its harsh conditions. Whether burrows of nocturnal bat-eared foxes or massive colonies of harvester ants, this ecosystem offers a wealth of resources to its native wildlife.

In this programme we look at the Vredefort Crater in South Africa and the life it supports. From rocky outcrops to grassland, and from wetlands to mighty rivers, each habitat provides a niche for a host of creatures.
Hidden within the Kalahari Desert and pulsating with natural beauty, the Okavango attracts scores of animals to its lush waters.
Explore the riveting dramas that play out amongst predators and their prey.
Get schooled in the art of protection by nature's most successful survivors.
Investigate the power of kinship and see why family shapes every animal's story.

Head to the heart of Central Kalimantan, Borneo—home to one of the most unique schools in the world. There are 68 students in all, including class clown Valentino (who loves a short-cut) and class couple Darril and Liti (who have their first fight).

Best buds Valentino, Madara and Utris are ready for the next stage of forest school. Baby Clarita is at long last reunited with her mother. And toddler Mema discovers a tasty treat inside a rotten log (it can happen!).

Leopard problems plague the community as hunger-ravaged predators roam dangerously close to nearby villages. The team at Ol Pejeta need to safely snare a leopard and relocate it for the good of man and beast.
Some orangutans steal food, others cut class. It's a truly wild day at school.
The African Penguin is the only penguin species that breeds in Africa, and it is found nowhere else.
At the southern edge of the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetland on Earth, there's a place like no other, and a wildlife so diverse scientists scramble to understand it.
In the heart of the Pantanal wetlands lies a region so remote that it is almost entirely unvisited. 300 pig-like peccaries call this unique place their home.

p.t: Mama Twiga in the Garden of Eden
p.d: Mama Twiga in the Garden of Eden tells the emotional story of a mother giraffe, Mama Twiga, and the struggles of young giraffes and gazelles as they take on the risks of growing in the wilds of Swahili.
When a complicated Texas love triangle ends in murder, a pink gun leads to an arrest, until new evidence prompts investigators to rethink the case.
The mysterious death of a young mother in Ohio and the ensuing investigation that spans years and multiple states.
A murder case considered closed by North Dakota detectives is suddenly reopened when a confidential informant comes forward with a tip about an unlikely suspect.
Police investigate whether the shooting of a young woman in Utah was an accident or something more sinister.
A pilot flees following a plane crash, becomes a fugitive and lives a double life for decades.
A couple's anniversary celebration ends in murder during what appears to have been a home invasion, but investigators believe the suspect might be connected to the victim.

Josh now has to tell his girlfriend, Autumn, that not only did he cheat on her, but he also has a child with another! Next Robert has been keeping secrets for a long time! He's been sleeping with both Tori and Shelly for almost 9 years!

Jake is here because he says that he knew he was in love with his girlfriend Lindsey the first time she ever asked him for a side of cheese. Then Shaina says she's in love with not one but two beautiful girls.
A boyfriend gets his girl's friend pregnant; a man dumps his wife for a friend of the family; an ex-roommate sleeps around with woman's boyfriend.

Tia says she has proof that her brother-in-law cheats on her sister; Maranda wants to get back together with her ex-fiance but believes it could stir up problems with her best friend; Kaila wants a threesome.

A stripper says she took her friend under her wing and taught her the profession, but then her friend hooked up with one of her clients, and she feels betrayed; a man is unsure if he can forgive his lover for cheating when they're expecting a baby.

Justin says that Ashley's so overbearing and protective that it drove him to cheat on her with her lifelong friend Erica. Then, Tina is here to confront her sister Ruthie for cheating with her man Tony.
Arianna learns that her girlfriend has another on the side; Anthony says he made a mistake in cheating on his girlfriend, but the other woman will stop at nothing to be with him.

A woman wants to confront her husband, who says he is unable to quit cheating with someone else, despite the fact that he wants to make things work with his wife; a woman hopes to make her relationship with her sister even better.

Antiatte's friend and sister determine whether she will accept her boyfriend's marriage proposal; two women battle it out for a porn star's love; Britanny says something is fishy about her boyfriend's behavior.
A woman catches her boyfriend with another woman; a man cheats on his wife with her good friend; a man sleeps with his fiancee's cousin.
Paige seeks commitment, Monica suspects cheating, Ashleigh tests love with a talent show.

Today's guests say they are about to open the floodgates on their world of lies. They're drowning in miserable relationships and are here to save themselves. They want out of their relationships, and their lovers are about to find out.

A woman wants to know what actions she can take to speed up her divorce because her future ex-husband keeps delaying the process, and a homeowner is wondering if it’s illegal for a property manager to show up unannounced for home inspections.
A man believes he was falsely terminated for sexual harassment after asking multiple co-workers to spend time with him after work. But is Byron buying his good guy story?
Girlfriends confront boyfriends who dumped them over refusing abortions and baby involvement.

Spice Girl Mel B joins Bear on the two hundred foot cliffs of the Welsh coastline, where a final descent sends Mel into breakdown mode; Bear is stung by a jellyfish, forcing Mel to practice some first aid skills.
Catfish and Rooftop fight modern day Ukrainian Amazons, visit the Chernobyl nuclear meltdown site, and work with Ukraine's largest tiger performance act.
Catfish and Rooftop take on the national team of Bangladesh in the extreme contact sport of Kabaddi.

Mario takes on the unforgiving alpine mountains of the south island of New Zealand in a gruelling fallow deer hunt with his bow at the end of the rutt and cooks an impressive venison pie dish on the same antler of the deer he harvests.

Mario enjoys duck hunting on opening day, then learns an ancient Chinese recipe with an award-winning chef. After fly fishing on a South Island river, he demonstrates how to smoke trout with a matching aioli.

After being dropped off into the mountains where there were only whispers and tales of mountain monsters being seen. Mario is on the search of the outer limits of the mountains to find himself a monster red deer. His arrow successfully finds a big red and he showcases some recipes he learnt from the southern regions of Italy form leading celebrity chefs. p.d: The Destiny crew must fight for their lives when members of the Lucian Alliance come through the Stargate.
The Destiny continues its journey through the universe, while its crew suffer from a lack of supplies and no knowledge of its final destination.
The control of the Destiny hangs in the balance while the battle rages between the crew and the Lucian Alliance. Plus, Tamara receives some startling news.
The team think they've discovered the key to getting home when they climb on board a mysterious Stargate seeding ship. A few surprises are in store however...

Eli and Rush discover that Chloe is infected with a dangerous pathogen and search for a way to rid her of it before their enemies are able to use it against the entire crew; Eli returns to Earth to help his mother, who is ill.

Col Young fears he's losing his mind after a recurring vision in which the Destiny is attacked and destroyed. Meanwhile, Rush visits Chloe in isolation.
The Destiny is left stranded in space after an encounter with a damaged ship. While Young goes into panic mode, Rush refuses to divulge a valuable secret.
Blood is spilled when Simeon makes his escape, sending Rush on a vengeful mission. Hot in pursuit are Young and Greer, who must bring Simeon back unharmed.
Emotions run high when the team are reunited with Destiny crew members left behind more than a year ago. All is not well with their former comrades though...
All is not as it seems when Rush and co encounter a sea of wrecked ships and decide to investigate. Chloe succumbs deeper to the alien infection too.
Locked in a battle with a Drone Command Ship, the Destiny is surprised by the arrival of the Aliens that abducted Rush and Chloe.
Excitement spreads through the ship as Eli believes he's found a way to dial Earth, only Dr. Rush has serious reservations about the plan and abandoning Destiny.
In a particularly suspenseful instalment, Greer and Wray are caught up in an attack that culminates with an alien ship crash-landing into Homeworld Command.
Chloe falls asleep while using the communication stones and wakes up with Ginn's consciousness in her body. Meanwhile, Tamara delivers some bad news to Volker.

On 8 July 1947, the US Air Force announced a flying disc had crashed near Roswell, New Mexico, sparking the flying saucer phenomenon. Against the Cold War backdrop, conspiracy theories ran wild.
